# foreman_jobtemplate (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foreman_jobtemplate" "restart_service" {
  name          = "Restart service"
  description   = "Restarts a named service via the default job template provider"
  job_category  = "Services"
  provider_type = "script"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `job_category` (String)
- `provider_type` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import foreman_jobtemplate.restart_service <jobtemplate_id>
```
